tasks.title: Console adopts the fixed contract with its read and write wrappers unchanged
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Shared finding, all Behavior bullets and Completion evidence; Rollout order 2, Performance impact, Security impact and Acceptance evidence (whole feature) 5. After contract merges, record/reuse the same full merged main SHA as other consumers. Update pin/lock together; preserve src/api-read.ts and src/connection-test.ts manual redirect wrappers, writes and src/api-failure.ts wire-label logic.

acceptance.command: bun install && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check
acceptance.expected: exit 0; lint, both typecheck projects including e2e, full tests and unchanged >=80% line coverage pass, including existing redirect cases in src/runtime-read.test.ts, src/connection-test.test.ts, src/check-write.test.ts and src/token-write.test.ts.
exit 0, no output; read/write wrappers and wire-label logic are unchanged.

Only the contract dependency line changes in package.json, to github:lorenzh/pulse-contract#<full merged main SHA containing #864/version 2.5.2>; bun.lock resolves that same SHA. Verify the merge on contract main independently and record/reuse the shared finding from the first consumer so probe, status, notify and console adopt the same SHA. Commit package.json and bun.lock together; other pins stay unchanged.

acceptance.command: bash -c 'TIMEFORMAT="%U %S"; for run in 1 2 3; do time bun run test; done'
acceptance.expected: Per Performance impact's primary measurement in each changed repository, run three test suites per side on main and candidate on the same machine, reporting individual user+system sums and medians. Use bash builtin time, not /usr/bin/time; no extra test CPU is expected from this pin adoption.
exit 0 with installed Playwright Chromium; existing console browser flows pass against the adopted contract.

Required CI check, docker, browser and deploy-dev jobs pass. deploy-dev must build the pulse-deploy main dev Compose stack with this checkout, wait ready, then run E2E_CONSOLE_FLOW=two-factor bash e2e/console-setup.sh dev/compose.yaml with exit 0, as .github/workflows/ci.yml/AGENTS.md require. Do not edit deploy or weaken this job. PR records full merged contract SHA and shared-finding provenance, check results and the applicable Security impact checklist: fixed secret-safe diagnostics, bounded bodies, redirect protection and full-SHA/lockfile consistency. No new dependency or setting. PR records browser/Compose results, empty src diff and CPU medians.
